notes.title: Steam Community Items for Wavetale have been washed ashore!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42687583/514b1a1da87b4b64dddb3522aa7361086e4414f4.jpg

Happy Monday friends!

And what a happy Monday it is! You, who have spent some hours in the waterproof shoes of Sigrid, you will now receive an additional reward for fighting the dirty paws! ːsteamhappyː Because as of now Steam Community Items are available for Wavetale:

 5 Emoticons
 5 Profile Backgrounds
 6 Trading Cards
 Badge (5 Levels + Foil Badge)

Have a great time everyone, and take care!
The Wavetale Team

notes.title: ❄️ Winter Holiday Colouring Contest! ❄️
notes.content:
❄️ Happy festive holidays, friends! ❄️

Finally, the winter holidays are here. And could there be a better way to celebrate this festivity than having a creative contest? Spoiler: Of course not!

So, it's time for you to show us your artist and colouring expertise! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41486220/fbe3cbc9583f7ba4779c94e1a5a07a9aead98a7e.png

We will select five winners on the 21st of December. Those five lucky ones will receive Steam keys each for Swordship, Tinkertown, Togges and Wavetale. So you definitely won't be bored over the holidays!

How to participate:
Download the image, and you're ready to go. Do whatever you want! You have the freedom to add your unique flair or additions. 🖌️ 
Join our Discord server and upload your image in the #tfwintercontest channel or use the same hashtag on Twitter for your chance to win!!
The contest ends on the 21st of December at 15.00 CET, and the winners will be presented on Discord and our Social Media channels.

Terms and Conditions: https://thunderfulgames.com/privacy-policy/

We hope you have a wonderful winter holiday! ❄️

Happy creative colouring everyone!
The Thunderful Community Team
